rulings.text: Orchestrator grants fix/audit rounds and routes non-converging PRs (analysis, split, card, park) itself; never asks the operator for rounds or waivers (R928).
Acting judge uses the R10 grid; not-real needs live-head evidence plus a second-model check; may swap a block for a card on pre-existing carded findings.
Standing powers: fast-forward the primary checkout (never reset or force); stop own stale verify runs by PID; clear proven-dead Forge slot markers, reporting root cause.

Never: --force / push -f, MAIN_PUSH_OK, WE_LAND_UNVERIFIED, WE_MERGE_BREAK_GLASS, --requireVerified=false / --no-require-verified, --allow-conflict, pkill, broad rm, reading ~/.secrets or printing tokens, hand-editing daemon clones or state
Always the operator's: secrets/access storage changes, Forge root deploys, irreversible deletion, pricing/licensing. PR-introduced security findings are never emergency-approvable.
No paid GitHub runners or paid cloud without explicit operator OK; capacity is this Mac, free GitHub runners and Forge until the Mac Studio.
Forge is test/compute only: no AI logins or sessions, no secrets beyond the runner token, no slot-user egress; GitHub-writing and AI daemons stay on Mac.
Forge bundle scan always refuses real token formats, credential files, .env/*.pem/id_* files and unreadable content; generic high-entropy hits only warn and log.
A credential-named or credential-pattern file ships to Forge only if git-tracked, byte-identical to origin/main, not a symlink, and passing the content scan.
Forge root installs happen in daytime with the operator present, right after their PRs merge; never overnight until automated rollback exists.
When PRs pile up but capacity is free, build prototypes or debug branches without opening PRs; graduate them once the queue drains.
Codex implements; Claude orchestrates, skims, tests and audits. Gemini gets mechanical jobs only, one at a time, with an outside-folder write check.
Prepare before building: acceptance, pre-mortem, touch-set, test plan; threat model for untrusted-output work; Opus safety-property pass first for guard or daemon builds.
Two separate Ultra accounts: build and fix run on account B; review, verify, health-watch and drain on A; bg sessions stay on A.
One capacity gate: idle CPU % plus free memory decides admission; load average is display only; every high-load report includes the load-explain breakdown.
Forge offload health is a top blocker like red main: handle any Forge problem or fallback class at once, in debug mode.
Forge-routing fixes take the shortest path: build, targeted tests, one advisory audit, normal PR; proof is the heavy-local report after merge.
Main CI stays on GitHub-hosted runners; Forge CI is tried only on trial branches as a prototype, never by re-routing main CI.
Session-only setup (crons, monitor, subscriptions) lives in session-setup.md, recreated each session; log each ruling the same turn; consolidate weekly and after 25 new rulings.
Policies live as settings in the policy cascade with source logged; settings may narrow, code sets outer limits; provider switches never need code.
Direction: own state first, GitHub secondary: one scheduler replaces daemons; merge work moves into merge queue; adapter keeps chat approvals; merge-only heads skip re-approval.
Mac Studio adds a second machine, not a migration: no machine-local trust state; distributed builds come progressively; design only until it arrives (~2026-11-15).
